page.intro: Pair this Safe with a dapp as if it were a wallet. Incoming requests are converted into Safe proposals — see docs/WALLETCONNECT_WALLET_SETUP.md for setup and limitations.
page.uriHint: Paste the wc: URI shown by the connecting dapp.
page.connectWalletFirst: Connect a wallet first — it will sign proposals raised from incoming requests.
page.wantsToConnect: {{name}} ({{url}}) wants to connect to this Safe.

panel.unsupportedMethod: This wallet only handles {{expected}} requests — received "{{received}}".
panel.expiryInvalid: Expiry rounds must be between 1 and {{max}}.
panel.proposalCreated: Proposal #{{proposalId}} created on-chain (tx {{txId}}). Approve it from the Proposals page once the group reaches threshold.
panel.convertedReject: Converted into Safe proposal #{{proposalId}} — track and approve it from the Safe console.
panel.signedReturned: Signed the proposal call (tx {{txId}}) and returned it to the paired dapp — note this is the Safe proposal transaction, not the original requested transaction(s).
panel.cantBecome: This request can't become a Safe proposal
panel.groupIdHint: The group that will hold this proposal.
panel.expiryHint: Added to the current round to compute the proposal expiry round.
panel.signReturnNote: "Sign & Return" sends back the signed proposal transaction, not the dapp's original transaction(s) — only use it with dapps that accept that. Prefer submitting to chain and letting the dapp poll the Safe's proposal status.

service.noAlgorandNamespace: This dapp's session proposal did not request the Algorand namespace, so this Safe can't service it.

hook.pairFailed: Failed to pair with the WalletConnect URI.
hook.approveFailed: Failed to approve the session proposal.
hook.rejectSessionFailed: Failed to reject the session proposal.

convert.unrecognizedShape: Unrecognized algo_signTxn request shape — expected an array of {txn, signers?} entries.
convert.noTransactions: The request did not contain any transactions.
convert.unsignedByOthers: This request bundles a transaction that must be authorized by another party (its "signers" list is empty) — for example a LogicSig-controlled account or a different multisig member. The Safe can only co-sign transactions sent from its own address or from addresses rekeyed to it, so this batch cannot be turned into a Safe proposal. Reject it and ask the dapp to route that part of the request through the original signer directly.
convert.decodeFailed: One of the transactions in this request could not be decoded — it may already be signed (e.g. a LogicSig blob) rather than a plain unsigned transaction.
convert.notSpendable: Transaction sender {{sender}} is neither the Safe's own address nor an address currently rekeyed to it. The Safe has no authority to move funds from this account, so this request can't become a Safe proposal.
convert.cannotRepresent: The Safe can't represent this transaction: {{message}}
convert.cannotRepresentGeneric: The Safe cannot represent one of the transactions in this request.
